decision: Detect routing, artifact-equivalence, reconciliation, authority, Bugfix-classification, readiness, and implementation-boundary failures in quick-change before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Producing the canonical Change Specification and Change Design together for one bounded Change, reconciling them, and returning a thin coordination handoff without planning or implementation.
scope.case_source: Synthetic explicit combined requests, adjacent ordinary implementation language, Defect remediation, missing authority, and missing semantic Protocol cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or abstention is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic sources, Gen Stack knowledge, and no implementation or release authority.

evidence.storage: Keep versioned source under evals and routine generated runs only in the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of artifact structure, semantics, reconciliation, classification, and authority.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: The same target system without quick-change under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when meaningful.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring value.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates and material assertions pass for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: The Change Specification uses the exact shared canonical fallback and contains no executable test realization or delivery coordination.
The skill does not invent ratification or a semantic Protocol merely to finish.
The Change is classified as Bugfix because established Defects and explicit authorized remediation are supplied.
The response does not plan, implement, review, or ship.
Quick-change is not selected for an ordinary quick implementation request.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
